experiments.system: Conditional clean-room reconstruction: frozen ImageNet ResNet-18 hidden encoder, trainable 512-unit frame projection, one-layer 512-unit LSTM, 64-way classifier
experiments.checkpoint_rule: Report fixed epoch 30, matching Table 3; no held-out-score checkpoint selection
